paper_metadata.title: Chinese CLIP: Contrastive Vision-Language Pretraining in Chinese
paper_metadata.abstract: The tremendous success of CLIP (Radford et al., 2021) has promoted the research and application of contrastive learning for vision-language pretraining. In this work, we construct a large-scale dataset of image-text pairs in Chinese, where most data are retrieved from publicly available datasets, and we pretrain Chinese CLIP models on the new dataset. We develop 5 Chinese CLIP models of multiple sizes, spanning from 77 to 958 million parameters. Furthermore, we propose a two-stage pretraining method, where the model is first trained with the image encoder frozen and then trained with all parameters being optimized, to achieve enhanced model performance. Our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Chinese CLIP can achieve the state-of-the-art performance on MUGE, Flickr30K-CN, and COCO-CN in the setups of zero-shot learning and finetuning, and it is able to achieve competitive performance in zero-shot image classification based on the evaluation on the ELEVATER benchmark (Li et al., 2022). We have released our codes, models, and demos in https://github.com/OFA-Sys/Chinese-CLIP

extraction_data.innovation: Two-stage pretraining method: Stage 1 uses Locked-Image Tuning (freezing the image encoder and optimizing only the text encoder) to inherit from foundation models; Stage 2 uses contrastive tuning (unfreezing and optimizing both encoders) to effectively transfer to language-specific Chinese data.

extraction_data.finetuning_task: Zero-shot learning, finetuning, image classification, Zero-shot classification, fine-tuning on cross-modal retrieval
extraction_data.hardware_used: NVIDIA V100 GPUs, NVIDIA A100 GPUs
extraction_data.research_problem: Vision-language pretraining in Chinese / transferring foundation models to language-specific scenarios
extraction_data.application: Cross-modal retrieval, zero-shot classification, image generation foundation model, search engine, recommender system

extraction_data.finetuning_data: MUGE, Flickr30K-CN, COCO-CN, ELEVATER benchmark, ICR dataset

extraction_data.benchmark_result: SOTA on MUGE, Flickr30K-CN, COCO-CN (zero-shot and finetuning); competitive on ELEVATER (zero-shot image classification); MR 42.6 (Tiny); MR 47.4 (Base); State-of-the-art on multiple cross-modal retrieval datasets in zero-shot and fine-tuning; competitive on 10 zero-shot image classification datasets; State-of-the-art on cross-modal retrieval tasks with long texts; zero-shot classification on 20 datasets (Win ELEVATER track)

extraction_data.innovation: Contrastive vision-language pretraining specifically for Chinese; a two-stage training method; systematic handcrafted prompt engineering to improve zero-shot classification performance; ONNX/TensorRT deployment pipeline for inference acceleration without accuracy loss.
